title: Voice input and output
description: Browser recording, turn state, recorded transcription and speech streaming.
useCases: Browser recording, turn state, recorded transcription and speech streaming.

systemRequirements: HTTPS or localhost and browser media support

steps: Read the README and run the local example first.
Preserve module/shared package layout and install the listed dependencies.
Use server adapters only from authenticated bounded handlers; never expose provider keys in browser bundles.

modes.local: Credential-free deterministic code and labeled synthetic fixtures.
modes.live: Configured provider adapters; never automatic fixture fallback.

verification.local: 9 local tests passed; scoped checkout typecheck, ESLint and credential-free example passed (35 combined experience tests).
verification.exported: Passed 2026-10-09: standalone full recipe npm ci, types, module tests, build and local HTTP run; provider verification is separate.
verification.live: not run — requires operator test credentials and authorization

limitations: Turn-based recorded-file path; continuous microphone transcription is an extension recipe.
Microphone requires HTTPS/localhost and permission; hardware not exercised by unit tests.
cost: Local mode has no API charges. Provider requests incur account-specific usage; no live calls performed.
provenance: Original kit implementation and authored synthetic fixtures. Provider docs cited in README; provider terms apply to live data.
